instruction: Design a system that combines a shift register and a combinational circuit. The shift register should be of length 3 and use a single D flip-flop to shift the input through the register. The combinational circuit should have five inputs, in[4:0], and three outputs: out_and, out_or, and out_nor. Additionally, include a control logic module that uses the output of the shift register to enable or disable the output of the combinational circuit. Connect the decoder to the input signals and use the decoder output as the input to the AND, OR, and NOR gates.
label: trojan
